objective_value: <float> Total power cost across all sensors, where each sensor's cost is the maximum weight among its chosen links.
selected_edges: <list[list[int]], length num_selected_edges> Pairs of sensor identifiers for each communication link chosen in the spanning subgraph.
vertex_costs: <dict, key: '{sensor_id}'> Power cost paid by each sensor, equal to the maximum weight among chosen links incident to that sensor.
